_comment: The author's decisions on batch 7's proposals: SYD2 merged into the Lane Cove West consent row
(the seed row is retired from seed_data.py), Apollo Place operator AirTrunk, Macquarie Park
operational, Kemps Creek's unlabelled 190 MW cleared, MEL2 and Wesley Vale added without
capacity, RG-001 and RG-082 closed, RG-104 left open. Loads after batch7_open_questions.json,

set.name: AirTrunk SYD2 (Lane Cove West Data Centre)
set.notes: SCHEDULE 1 APPLICANT ON THE SIGNED CONSENT: Greenbox Architecture Pty Ltd. The Schedule 1 applicant is Greenbox Architecture Pty Ltd - an ARCHITECTURAL PRACTICE holding a 2019 data centre consent. A fifth consultancy-type applicant in the sample, and the earliest consent in the Lane Cove cluster. Applicant recovered in the 2026-09-18 pypdf re-extraction (RG-065). AirTrunk's own page makes this consent its SYD2 facility (RG-098; the separate SYD2 row was merged into this one on 2026-11-18). DECIDED BY THE AUTHOR 2026-11-18 (research batch 7): RG-098: this consent's facility is AirTrunk SYD2. AirTrunk's own SYD2 page credits Greenbox Architecture, this consent's applicant, with delivering it 'in collaboration with AirTrunk', dates it from 2019, places it at 1 Sirius Road, and calls it 'one of Australia's largest hyperscale data centre campuses'; it calls the 1 Sirius Road facility 'existing'. The separate seed row SITE_AIRTRUNK_SYD2 is retired and its HCF certification (the register's 'AirTrunk Australia - SYD1, SYD2 and MEL1') now matches this row. Its other claims rested on CertifiedStrategic.com and are not carried. Site area stays the consent's 3.59 ha; AirTrunk's 'Set on 4.2ha' is quoted, not stored, as the campus may include later phases. No capacity is stored: AirTrunk gives only a lower bound ('120+MW').

add_sources.quote: Through close collaboration with AirTrunk and specialist consultants, Greenbox Architecture delivered a future‑ready data centre environment | The Apollo Place data centre has been located adjacent to AirTrunk’s existing facility at 1 Sirius Road. | AirTrunk SYD2 is one of Australia’s largest hyperscale data centre campuses, delivering high‑performance digital infrastructure at scale. | Set on 4.2ha

set.notes: SCHEDULE 1 APPLICANT ON THE SIGNED CONSENT: EMKC Cubed Management Pty Ltd, which also holds the 51 Huntingwood Drive consent in Blacktown. The Department's assessment report says the applicant 'has been approached by a data centre operator (the end user)' that operates the co-located Lane Cove West Data Centre. AirTrunk's own SYD2 page calls Apollo Place 'Phase 5 of AirTrunk's investment within the precinct' (RG-098). ASIC's register shows EMKC Cubed Management Pty Ltd had been named CKTSME Management Pty Ltd since 3 June 2025, four months before the consent was determined on 9 October 2025. CORRECTED 2026-10-22: earlier notes placed 51 Huntingwood Drive in Lane Cove. DECIDED BY THE AUTHOR 2026-11-18 (research batch 7): RG-098: operator AirTrunk, REPORTED on AirTrunk's own SYD2 page, which says this development 'has been located adjacent to AirTrunk's existing facility at 1 Sirius Road' and 'is Phase 5 of AirTrunk's investment within the precinct'. The consent's applicant (EMKC Cubed Management) is unchanged.

add_sources.quote: The Apollo Place data centre has been located adjacent to AirTrunk’s existing facility at 1 Sirius Road. | The project is Phase 5 of AirTrunk’s investment within the precinct.

set.notes: SCHEDULE 1 APPLICANT ON THE SIGNED CONSENT: Stockland Trust Management Limited (SSD-10467, determined 28 May 2021) - a second Stockland entity alongside Stockland Development Pty Limited at 1-5 Khartoum Road (SSD-63235720, a different lot, still a separate record). Applicant recovered in the 2026-09-18 pypdf re-extraction (RG-065). MERGED 2026-11-15 (RG-084, approved by the author): the former SITE_STOCKLAND_MP row ('Stockland Macquarie Park Stage 1 data centre') described this same consent and has been retired; what it held is carried here. The consent's site is 11-17 Khartoum Road AND 33-39 Talavera Road, Lot 1 DP 633221 - the address previously recorded named only the Khartoum Road frontage. The Department's assessment gives a CIV of approximately $263.6 million (the retired row said A$264m) and describes a development that 'presents as a five-storey warehouse building' (the retired row said five-storey). Status stays 'approved', which is what the consent records. NOT adopted from the retired row: 'under construction', an AWS end-user and a north-zone start in September 2026. Those were seeded from CertifiedStrategic.com, whose archived article does not mention Stockland at all, so no archived source states them; they are unconfirmed claims, kept here as claims and put to a human as RG-102. No IT capacity is recorded: the retired row had none and no capacity has been read from this consent. DECIDED BY THE AUTHOR 2026-11-18 (research batch 7): RG-102: status operational (it read approved). The Department's March 2026 report on the neighbouring SSD-63235720 describes 'an existing data centre adjoining to the west at 11-17 Khartoum Road (SSD-10467)' and counts it among 'one operational data centre'. Its end user is still unnamed.

add_sources.quote: an existing data centre adjoining to the west at 11 - 17 Khartoum Road (SSD - 10467) | including one operational data centre, one under - construction data centre, and one data centre currently under assessment

set.notes: SSD-10101987, approved 13 July 2023. See the RG-013 pack. DECIDED BY THE AUTHOR 2026-11-18 (research batch 7): RG-024: it_capacity_mw is cleared. sites.name: AirTrunk MEL2 (Melbourne North-West)
sites.notes: Added on the author's decision of 2026-11-18 (RG-071), from AirTrunk's own MEL2 page: 'Strategically located in Melbourne's North-West', 'Set on 8.070 ha with 45,578sqm of gross floor area'. STATUS IS A RECORDED READING: the page gives no status and no planning record has been read, so the row takes pre_lodgement, the earliest stage the vocabulary has; a planning record will move it. NO CAPACITY IS STORED: 'a total capacity of 354+MW' is a lower bound. No address or suburb is published (directories say Tullamarine: a lead), so the row is not mapped.

set.notes: OPENED 2026-10-10 from AirTrunk's own SYD2 page (archived at data/raw/operators/airtrunk/syd2-sydney-north.txt). It places SYD2 at 1 Sirius Road, which is the site of SSD-9741, whose applicant was Greenbox Architecture, and it says Greenbox Architecture 'delivered' SYD2 in collaboration with AirTrunk. Under 'Apollo Place Data Centre' it says the development 'has been located adjacent to AirTrunk's existing facility at 1 Sirius Road', that the two 'will form an integrated data centre campus', and that 'The project is Phase 5 of AirTrunk's investment within the precinct'. Neither record is merged and no operator is filled: merging records and naming an operator are for a human. UPDATED 2026-11-18 (research batch 7): ANSWERED FROM THE OPERATOR'S OWN PAGE; THE RECORD CHANGE IS THE AUTHOR'S. AirTrunk's SYD2 page credits Greenbox Architecture, SSD-9741's applicant, with delivering SYD2 'in collaboration with AirTrunk', dates it '2019 - ongoing' (SSD-9741 was determined on 15 November 2019, and its report described a client with 'two data centres in Melbourne and western Sydney'), places it at 1 Sirius Road and links to the planning portal; and says the Apollo Place data centre (SSD-67407231) 'has been located adjacent to AirTrunk's existing facility at 1 Sirius Road' and 'is Phase 5 of AirTrunk's investment within the precinct'. PROPOSED for the author: (1) SITE_LANE_COVE_WEST is the consent for the facility SITE_AIRTRUNK_SYD2 records, so the two are one site, as RG-084 found for Macquarie Park; (2) SITE_APOLLO_PLACE's operator is AirTrunk, REPORTED on the operator's own statement. Neither change is made by this pack. DECIDED BY THE AUTHOR 2026-11-18 (research batch 7): Both proposals accepted: SITE_LANE_COVE_WEST is now the SYD2 record (operator AirTrunk, operational; SITE_AIRTRUNK_SYD2 retired), and Apollo Place's operator is AirTrunk, REPORTED.

OPENED 2026-11-15 by the RG-084 merge. The seed row cited SRC_CERTSTRAT for 'A$264m', 'for AWS' and 'a north-zone start in September 2026'. The archived article (data/raw/operators/certifiedstrategic/) does not contain the word 'Stockland' - checked by this script and by curate_certstrat_review.py - so the citation never supported the claim. The consent itself records approval, not construction. Nothing here has been read that names an end user or a start date. Until one is, the surviving row keeps status 'approved' and no anchor tenant. One lead, no more: the NSW IDA release of 27 March 2026 lists 'Stockland Project A City of Ryde' (recorded separately as SITE_STOCKLAND_PROJA) and states '**NB: One IDA endorsed data centre not listed due to commercial sensitivities**'. Whether the withheld project is this one is unknown and is not assumed. UPDATED 2026-11-18 (research batch 7): CONSTRUCTION ANSWERED, END USER NOT. The Department's March 2026 report on the neighbouring SSD-63235720 describes 'an existing data centre adjoining to the west at 11-17 Khartoum Road (SSD-10467)' and lists, among adjoining sites, 'one operational data centre, one under-construction data centre, and one data centre currently under assessment'. So SSD-10467 was built and operating by March 2026. Its own 2021 report says only that 'The Applicant has been approached by a data centre operator (the lessee)' who would operate it: one of the nine unnamed operators (RG-055). PROPOSED for the author: SITE_MACQUARIE_PARK_DC status `approved` -> `operational`, REPORTED on the Department's description. Not made by this pack. DECIDED BY THE AUTHOR 2026-11-18 (research batch 7): Status set to operational. The end user stays unnamed, so the question stays open for it.

UPDATED 2026-11-18 (research batch 7): PRIMARY SOURCE READ: the Department's assessment report for SSD-10101987 (July 2023) confirms 'The site is approximately 14.43 hectares (ha) in area' and 'a gross floor area (GFA) of 60,943 m2', matching the row. But its capacity is 'two data storage buildings with an operational capacity of 190 Megawatts (MW)': the measure is not labelled IT load, and the row stores 190 in it_capacity_mw. That is the mislabelling RG-099 removed elsewhere. PROPOSED for the author: clear it_capacity_mw on SITE_MSFT_KEMPS (no column holds an unlabelled figure; the passage is quoted), and cite the report for the area and GFA. Not made by this pack. Whether the campus is operating, and at what IT load, still needs Microsoft's own statement. DECIDED BY THE AUTHOR 2026-11-18 (research batch 7): it_capacity_mw cleared on SITE_MSFT_KEMPS; area and floor area confirmed from the assessment report. No primary source read states an IT load for the campus.

UPDATED 2026-11-18 (research batch 7): AirTrunk's own MEL2 page archived: 'Strategically located in Melbourne's North-West', 'a total capacity of 354+MW' (a lower bound, so no capacity value), 'Set on 8.070 ha with 45,578sqm of gross floor area and up to 32 technical data halls'. It gives no address, suburb or status, so no row is invented: sites.status has no 'unknown'. Directory listings and a trade photo caption say Tullamarine; those are leads, not records. PROPOSED for the author: a row SITE_AIRTRUNK_MEL2 (VIC, unmapped) only if the author accepts a status reading. OPENED 2026-11-15. Macquarie's own IC3 Super West page, read for this batch, says 'IC3 Super West is currently under construction with the entire end-state power secured', gives '47MW IT Load' and lists the facility as 'Coming Soon'. SITE_MACQ_IC3 is named 'IC3 Super West (Macquarie Park)' and recorded operational on SRC_CERTSTRAT, a grade-C directory. The register lists 'IC1, IC2, IC3 and IC3e' as Certified Strategic Enclaves; IC3 East is operational at 12 MW IT load and is added by this batch as SITE_MACQ_IC3E. Which building each register name denotes, and whether a facility under construction can hold Strategic certification, is for a human. NO VALUE IS CHANGED HERE: the page is quoted against the existing row so the contradiction is on the record, not resolved by an agent. DECIDED BY THE AUTHOR 2026-11-18 (research batch 7): The author cannot say which building the register's 'IC3' is. It stays open. What would settle it: Macquarie Data Centres naming the certified building, or the Hosting Certification Framework's certificate scope. No value changes.
